rules.applicability: Apple profile only; recognized USDA layers after safe container indexing. Skip when layer kind cannot be established.
rules.description: Text USD delivery advisory in Apple profile.
rules.rationale: Binary USD is the frozen portability recommendation; current Apple systems may support USDA. This advice neither certifies a renderer nor requires a single layer.
rules.title: Prefer binary USD delivery

rules.applicability: Apple profile only; recognized EXR or AVIF texture members after safe container indexing.
rules.description: EXR/AVIF outside the conservative PNG/JPEG Apple profile baseline.
rules.rationale: PNG/JPEG is the frozen portability recommendation; current Apple systems may support EXR or AVIF. This advice does not certify renderer compatibility.
rules.title: Prefer PNG or JPEG textures

rules.applicability: ZIP records whose required bytes or field ranges can be checked within the safety envelope. Unsupported features use a limitation when malformedness is not established.
rules.description: Established malformed/truncated ZIP record or invalid field range.
rules.rationale: A container cannot be trusted when required records are malformed or truncated.
rules.title: Malformed ZIP record

rules.applicability: Supported classic single-disk ZIP records after bounded metadata reads. Skip downstream checks whose ownership cannot be established.
rules.description: Contradictory local/directory records, overlapping ownership, or unindexed members.
rules.rationale: Directory and local records must describe consistent, nonoverlapping ownership of the package bytes.
rules.title: Contradictory ZIP ownership

rules.applicability: Safely indexed stored regular payloads that can be read completely within the safety envelope. Skip unsupported or unavailable payloads.
rules.rationale: The recorded CRC must match the encoded stored payload.
rules.title: Stored payload CRC mismatch

rules.applicability: Entries with established method and size fields, including zero/zero stored entries. Reject nonempty/zero claims before payload interpretation.
rules.description: Nonzero compression method or unequal stored/uncompressed sizes.
rules.rationale: The supported USDZ container uses stored payloads with equal encoded and uncompressed sizes.
rules.title: Entry is not stored one-to-one

rules.applicability: Entries whose ZIP encryption flags can be read conclusively.
rules.rationale: Encrypted entries are outside the permitted USDZ stored-container form.
rules.title: Encrypted entry

rules.applicability: Regular entries with safely established physical payload offsets; directory entries have no payload-alignment obligation.
rules.rationale: USDZ regular-file payloads require 64-byte alignment.
rules.title: Unaligned regular payload

rules.applicability: USD members with enough safely readable signature bytes for a conclusive mismatch. Insufficient bytes do not establish a mismatch.
rules.rationale: A USD filename must not contradict its recognizable text or binary signature.
rules.title: USD suffix and signature disagree

rules.applicability: Known input byte size with archiveBytes enabled; warn only when observed bytes exceed the threshold.
rules.rationale: Encoded archive bytes are a configurable project delivery budget, separate from hard safety limits.
rules.title: Archive byte budget exceeded

rules.applicability: Safely indexed regular entries with fileBytes enabled; warn only when encoded bytes exceed the threshold.
rules.rationale: A per-file encoded-byte warning identifies large package members without decoding them.
rules.title: File byte budget exceeded

rules.applicability: Established regular-entry count with fileCount enabled; warn only when the count exceeds the threshold.
rules.rationale: Regular-file count is a configurable delivery-complexity budget; directories do not count.
rules.title: File count budget exceeded

rules.applicability: Recognized texture members with textureBytes enabled and established stored sizes; warn only above the threshold.
rules.rationale: Encoded texture bytes measure delivery cost without decoding pixels.
rules.title: Texture byte budget exceeded

rules.applicability: Safely indexed recognized textures with totalTextureBytes enabled; warn only when their encoded-byte sum exceeds the threshold.
rules.rationale: Aggregate encoded texture bytes are a project budget independent of decoded memory cost.
rules.title: Total texture byte budget exceeded

rules.applicability: textureMaxDimension enabled and conclusive dimensions from a supported PNG/JPEG header within the scan boundary; warn only above the threshold.
rules.description: Supported texture width or height exceeds the dimension budget.
rules.rationale: Width or height is advisory delivery policy; no pixel decoding or decoded-memory estimate is performed.
rules.title: Texture dimension budget exceeded

rules.applicability: Supported PNG/JPEG headers with enough readable bytes to establish malformedness during an enabled dimension check.
rules.rationale: Conclusive malformedness is a policy error; unavailable or unsupported dimensions instead produce an explicit limitation when requested.
rules.title: Malformed texture header

rules.applicability: ZIP64, data descriptors, unsupported layouts, encodings, or type semantics where supported inspection cannot continue conclusively.
rules.description: Unsupported ZIP feature, layout, encoding, or type semantics.
rules.rationale: A processing boundary makes affected native coverage incomplete; it must not turn established malformed records into mere limitations.
rules.title: Unsupported ZIP semantics

rules.applicability: Recognized binary USD layers; package-local reference inspection cannot parse USDC dependencies in v0.1.
rules.rationale: Recognizing a binary signature does not prove complete USD reference validation.
rules.title: Binary references not inspected

rules.applicability: Recognized asset expressions, templates, or package identifiers outside the supported literal path subset.
rules.description: Expression/template/package identifier cannot be resolved natively.
rules.rationale: The validator does not evaluate expressions, composition, or nested package identifiers and cannot infer their targets.
rules.title: Unsupported asset identifier

rules.applicability: Recognized text USD whose encoding is outside the supported bounded USDA scanner.
rules.description: Recognized USD text cannot be scanned in its supported encoding.
rules.rationale: Unscannable recognized text leaves reference coverage incomplete without inventing missing-reference findings.
rules.title: USD text encoding not scanned

rules.applicability: textureMaxDimension enabled; unsupported formats, unsupported header variants, or no conclusive dimensions within the 1 MiB header scan boundary.
rules.description: Requested texture dimensions unavailable within the supported boundary.
rules.rationale: Dimension coverage must be explicit when bounded PNG/JPEG inspection cannot provide a result; the scan boundary alone is not a hard safety error.
rules.title: Texture dimensions unavailable

rules.applicability: Recognized nested .usdz members after safe container indexing; no recursive package inspection.
rules.rationale: The native engine does not extract or recursively inspect nested packages, so affected coverage remains incomplete.
rules.title: Nested package not inspected

rules.applicability: Raw archive member names available from safely bounded metadata; retain exact bytes for identity even when display is redacted.
rules.rationale: Package names must remain safe package-relative identifiers without host-filesystem resolution.
rules.title: Unsafe archive member name

rules.applicability: Safely indexed member names compared by exact case-sensitive UTF-8 bytes without Unicode normalization.
rules.description: Duplicate name or file/directory namespace conflict.
rules.rationale: A package namespace must not ambiguously assign a name to multiple entries or incompatible file/directory ownership.
rules.title: Conflicting package namespace

rules.applicability: Members whose supported ZIP attributes conclusively establish a prohibited type; unknown type semantics use a limitation.
rules.rationale: Package references must not depend on symlinks or prohibited special filesystem objects.
rules.title: Prohibited member type

rules.applicability: Conclusive asset literals from supported USDA scanning; absolute and external values are redacted by default.
rules.rationale: Standalone package references must not access external resources or unsafe host paths.
rules.title: Unsafe literal asset path

rules.applicability: Supported package-relative literal paths normalized against the containing layer; skip when safe layer identity is unavailable.
rules.rationale: Lexical reference resolution must remain within the package root.
rules.title: Reference escapes package root

rules.applicability: Supported safely normalized literals and a trustworthy package index; skip when a container failure makes target existence unknowable.
rules.description: Supported literal path has no regular package target.
rules.rationale: A supported package-local dependency must resolve to a regular package entry using exact UTF-8 identity.
rules.title: Missing regular package target

rules.applicability: The supported USDA asset-literal subset when scanning conclusively establishes malformedness; unsupported expressions use a limitation.
rules.rationale: Malformed supported syntax is an error without claiming complete USD grammar validation.
rules.title: Malformed supported asset literal

rules.applicability: A safely established first regular entry; skip when container ownership prevents determining entry order.
rules.description: First regular entry fails the standalone default-layer policy.
rules.rationale: This project requires the first regular entry to be a standalone USD default layer; it does not impose a universal single-layer requirement.
rules.title: Default layer policy failed

rules.applicability: Safely indexed members classified by the case-insensitive v0.1 suffix catalogue.
rules.description: Member outside the v0.1 suffix catalogue.
rules.rationale: The frozen member catalogue is project policy, not a universal claim about every future USDZ extension.
rules.title: Member suffix outside policy

rules.applicability: Any fixed safety-envelope ceiling; reserve the final finding slot when discovery is truncated and stop affected work.
rules.description: Hard safety/processing ceiling exceeded, including findings truncation.
rules.rationale: Hard resource limits protect bounded native processing, mark affected coverage incomplete, and remain blocking even when incomplete coverage is accepted.
rules.title: Hard processing ceiling exceeded
